_comment: One entry per show. 'rss_url' must be a real public RSS feed URL (the actual .xml/.rss address, not a Spotify or Apple Podcasts page link) — Spotify does not expose a public feed for any show, exclusive or not. Get the real feed URL from the show's host (Apple Podcasts 'Copy Feed URL' via a podcast app, Libsyn, Podbean, Simplecast, etc.) or from Podchaser / Listen Notes. Entries with a REPLACE_WITH_ value are skipped automatically and logged as skipped in podcast-log.md until filled in.

feeds.name: Open Residency
feeds.note: Hosted by Mark Brazil. Site: openresidency.com. Apple Podcasts id 1791782856 — get the real feed URL from there or the show's site.

feeds.name: The Grant Owen Podcast
feeds.note: Hosted on Podbean (grantowenpodcast.podbean.com). Podbean feeds are usually at https://feed.podbean.com/<subdomain>/feed.xml (so likely https://feed.podbean.com/grantowenpodcast/feed.xml) but this is an UNVERIFIED guess — confirm the real URL before relying on it.
